items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 172:1
items.html: The four Sefirot in the posterior of ZA are the place of the Nukva, that is, from the Chazeh [chest] and downward. And the reason for the matter, see above, answer 56. (Item 56).
